Maya (sales): Hey team — Rivermark POC kicked off today. They're asking about bringing a proprietary 7B LLaMA2-variant. Need to confirm catalog fit, quantization support, and pricing for Dedicated during POC. CC @Ibrahim @Nora @Olivia
Ibrahim (solutions): Can they share HF model id or a tarball? If it's a LLaMA2 derivative need eval of tokenizer and kv-cache compatibility.
Nora (infra): Archive size and fused kernels matter. What's peak seq len? Also on Dedicated we support int8 and int4 quant profiles but not all ops optimized.
Maya (sales): Customer says seq_len up to 8k for retrieval-augmented generation. Storage ~3.2GB on disk per variant. They want near-real-time <200ms token latency. Pricing question: POC 2-3 GPUs for 2 weeks, can we do short-term reserved rate?
Sam (ml): 8k is big. KV cache for 8k will pressure memory. Need to test batch=1 throughput and check compilation (kernel selection). We may need a special tiled attention fallback.
Olivia (security): Also they have an ATO checklist. Will send the security questionnaire. Need to confirm data-in-transit, KMS, and that model weights never leave customer VPC in Private mode.
Ibrahim (solutions): If they provide a model wheel we can run quick compatibility tests: tokenization parity, attention patterns. Can we ask for a small prompt set for accuracy baseline?
Maya (sales): Sent S3 link to model and sample prompts. Link: https://s3.redwood.example/rivermark/model.tar.gz (internal).
Nora (infra): I'll spin up a test on dev Dedicated pool. ETA ~3 hours. If kernel fallback used, expect +20-50% latency.
Sam (ml): Quantization note: for this architecture, int4 may cause hallucination drift. Recommend int8 first for POC unless they accept quality risk.
Maya (sales): Pricing: can sales give a quote for 2x A100 80GB for 2 weeks? Also need Dedicated burst policy to handle spikes.
Ibrahim (solutions): Pricing: recommend 'short-term commit' discount code STC-POC-15. Ops to confirm.
Olivia (security): Security: for SSO & audit logs we'll need SAML metadata and log-forwarding details. I'll attach questionnaire shortly.
DeployBot: deploy: test-job-1728456791 started on dev-dedicated-1
Nora (infra): Test started. Quick log: model load succeeded, tokenizer mismatch warnings present: 'unknown_token' for some special tokens. Will patch tokenizer mapping.
Maya (sales): Good. I'll relay tokenizer issue to customer and request a vocab mapping.
Ibrahim (solutions): Also check KV cache correctness — I saw divergent generated tokens on long prompts in initial run. Sam, can you run regen test with golden prompts?
Sam (ml): On it. Running 50 regen comparisons, will post diffs.
Maya (sales): Customer asks about rollback strategy if performance regresses in canary. We support automatic fallback to 4k variant. Confirm?
Nora (infra): Yes — routing policy can fallback to 4k-quantized-variant in edge cases. Need to set up route rules.
Maya (sales): Perfect. Next steps: Nora finish compatibility test, Sam produce quality/regen report, Olivia send security questionnaire, Ibrahim draft POC pricing & discount. I'll sync with customer tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
